title: In Eclipse Che versions 7.61.0 through 7.124.0 three related defects in the SCM-OAuth flow, chain… (CVE-2026-105609)
description: Eclipse Che versions 7.61.0 through 7.124.0 contain three related vulnerabilities in the SCM-OAuth authentication flow. These include an open redirect allowing redirection to attacker-controlled URLs, a missing CSRF nonce in the OAuth state parameter enabling token theft via crafted callbacks, and a concurrency issue where a singleton instance stores mutable per-request data leading to incorrect redirect behavior. These combined issues result in a high-severity security risk.
